proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change – Chapter 12: Cross-sectoral Perspectives (Carbon Dioxide Removal)
proposals.why: IPCC AR6 WGIII authoritative assessment: CDR is a necessary element to achieve net-zero CO2 and GHG emissions globally.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal 2024 – 2nd Edition
proposals.why: Global independent scientific assessment of CDR status, gap to Paris goals, and novel vs. conventional CDR trends.

proposals.title: The carbon dioxide removal gap
proposals.why: First quantification of the CDR gap: difference between national CDR plans and what 1.5 °C pathways require.

proposals.title: Evaluating the near- and long-term role of carbon dioxide removal in meeting global climate objectives
proposals.why: Shows gross emission cuts account for >80% of net GHG reductions to net-zero; CDR role grows in medium/long term.

proposals.title: Emissions Gap Report 2023: Broken Record – Temperatures hit new highs, yet world fails to cut emissions (again)
proposals.why: Annual UNEP assessment covering CDR potential, risks, and how delayed emission cuts increase future CDR reliance.

proposals.title: Greenhouse Gas Removal
proposals.first_author: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.container: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.why: Landmark joint academies report assessing GGR technologies and their role alongside emission cuts to reach net zero.

proposals.title: Governance of carbon dioxide removal: an AI-enhanced systematic map of the scientific literature
proposals.why: AI-enhanced systematic map of CDR governance literature, covering policy, certification, and scaling challenges.

proposals.title: IPCC Expert Meeting on Carbon Dioxide Removal Technologies and Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage
proposals.why: IPCC expert meeting report summarising CDR and CCUS technology roles in achieving net-zero CO2 or GHG emissions.
